{{Top|leg}}
'''Shelf Station 43''' was a [[Type 07034]] [[Water/Legends|underwater]] plant and [[Refinery/Legends|refinery]] manufactured by [[Rendeel Industries]]. It was located in the same [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] as [[Quekka Trench Station]]. During a battle between local government forces on the [[Planet/Legends|world]], a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] fell into the ocean and collided with Shelf Station 43, destroying the station.<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>
